mentions.name: SKrellM
mentions.description: SKrellM is a desktop system monitor that supports multiple graphical display backends (X11, SDL, and GDI already added), and is currently gaining native Wayland support; for now it runs on Weston through the SDL backend.
mentions.source_excerpt:
More backends for SKrellM.

https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48538174

After adding X11, SDL and GDI backends, now I'm working on a native Wayland support (for now, running through the SDL backend works on Weston).
